description: In trusted_issuer.rs test helper store_with_trusted_ca_cert_path(), the code does: let (tmp, path) = ca_der_to_pem_file(CA_CERT_DER); ... let store = TrustedIssuerStore::from_config(&[entry])...; drop(tmp); store. The NamedTempFile tmp is dropped explicitly before the store is returned. TrustedIssuerStore::from_config reads and parses the file at construction time (it stores the parsed SPKI/subject bytes, not the file path). So the store does NOT hold a reference to the file after construction; the drop is safe here. This is actually correct behavior -- flagging only because the explicit drop after construction is confusing to readers who may think the store holds a file reference. The code should add a comment explaining why the early drop is safe.
title: auth: trusted_issuer.rs store_with_trusted_ca_cert_path drops tempfile before store is used
